title: Claude built a 2.5D BOTW game in 4 days.
author: Automatic_Act_7303
selftext:
I just published my new web game, **The Shattered Mesa: A Legend of the Sky**, on CrazyGames! It’s a 2.5D action-adventure heavily inspired by the exploration and atmosphere of *Zelda: Breath of the Wild*.

* **Claude 3 Opus (Code & Logic):** Used Opus as the primary lead programmer. It was incredible at handling state management, weapon/combat mechanics, camera systems, and standardizing the HTML5/JS codebase to meet CrazyGames' performance and SDK requirements.
* **Gemini (Brainstorming & Narrative):** Gemini was my main tool for worldbuilding, level layout concepts, crafting dialogue, and writing asset generation prompts. Whenever I needed fast ideation or alternative narrative beats for the "floating sky/mesa" theme, Gemini delivered instantly.

**The pitch:** explore 5 very different regions (lush mesa, frozen ridge, scorching desert, a corrupted wasteland, a glowing neon jungle), master 4 ancient powers, and fight your way through a 65-room floating castle to a final boss.

It has pretty much every mechanic in BOTW but in 2.5D format.

Claude did all the heavy lifting in **4 days** and approved on CrazyGames for basic launch!
